facts.text: Le Meridien Frankfurt is located next to the main train station.
facts.excerpt: Located next to the main train station, Le Méridien Frankfurt is a hotel made for city trips and business visits.

facts.text: The hotel is set in the Bahnhofsviertel district, close to the main station.
facts.excerpt: set close to the main station in the energetic Bahnhofsviertel

facts.text: The Chic Palais rooms contain objects and features dating from as far back as 1905.
facts.excerpt: In our Chic Palais rooms you can discover objects and features that originate from as far back as 1905.

facts.text: The Chic Palais rooms blend Art Nouveau character with modern amenities.
facts.excerpt: Our Chic Palais rooms in Frankfurt blend Art Nouveau character with modern amenities.

facts.text: The Skyline Suite can be combined with two connecting Deluxe Rooms.
facts.excerpt: You can combine it with two Deluxe Rooms that are connected to the suite.

facts.text: The Skyline Suite has a spacious living room with a large table for meetings or private dinners.
facts.excerpt: It offers a spacious living room with a large table for meetings or private dinners and can be extended as you wish

facts.text: Rooms in the Legacy Wing look out over the Frankfurt skyline or the green Wiesenhuettenplatz.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the great view of Frankfurt's skyline or green Wiesenhüttenplatz

facts.text: Hotel guests get complimentary access to the Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt through the Unlock Art program.
facts.excerpt: Being our guest you enjoy complimentary access to Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt.

facts.text: The Roemerberg and the Schirn are about 15 minutes from the hotel on foot along the river Main.
facts.excerpt: Take a walk along the river Main, in direction of the city center and you will reach the Römerberg and SCHIRN in only 15 minutes from Le Méridien Frankfurt.

facts.text: The hotel lobby hosts changing exhibition projects of the Staedelschule art academy.
facts.excerpt: proudly present changing exhibition projects of the Städelschule in our hotel lobby

facts.text: Le Meridien Hub displays art pieces from galleries and art studios in the Bahnhofsviertel district.
facts.excerpt: A lot of galleries and art studios are located in the Bahnhofsviertel district which we support by displaying some of their art pieces at Le Méridien Hub.

facts.text: The fitness and sauna area has sun loungers outside on a roof terrace.
facts.excerpt: In the sauna or in the sun loungers outside on the roof terrace - complete relaxation awaits you

facts.text: The fitness terrace has a skyline view.
facts.excerpt: The fitness terrace with skyline view invites you to cool down and relax.

facts.text: The Legacy Bar & Grill serves casual, family-style dining, ribs and BBQ specialties from the smoker.
facts.excerpt: The Legacy Bar & Grill, with its Frankfurt bar atmosphere, serves casual, family-style dining, ribs, and BBQ specialties from the smoker.

facts.text: Smoky cocktails at The Legacy Bar are prepared with a smoking gun.
facts.excerpt: Try one of the smokey cocktails like Rob Roy Smokey, Negroni or Skye and Sea. They are prepared with a smoking gun

facts.text: Le Meridien Hub is a lobby gathering place with a co-working space.
facts.excerpt: Creative gathering place, co-working space + meeting point.

facts.text: The river Main is a short walk from the hotel and its embankments make a running path.
facts.excerpt: The river Main is only a short walk or quick run from Le Méridien Frankfurt and the perfect running + jogging path in the city.

facts.text: Many museums of the Museum Embankment are a few minutes' walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Thanks to the proximity of Le Méridien Frankfurt to the Main riverbanks, many museums are just a few minutes' walk away.

facts.text: Messe Frankfurt is about a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: It's just a 15 minutes walk or a short ride by public transportation

facts.text: Interconnecting rooms are available.
facts.excerpt: Interconnecting rooms are available, making the hotel a practical choice for family city explorers as well as business travelers.

facts.text: The New Frankfurt Old Town is about a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Wander through restored buildings in the New Frankfurt Old Town, just a 15 minutes walk away.

facts.text: The hotel is Green Key certified.
facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified

facts.text: The hotel calls itself one of the best hotels in Frankfurt.
facts.excerpt: Explore the city from one of the best hotels in Frankfurt
